original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹湖泊州伦拜克爆发激烈族群间武装冲突
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹湖泊州首府伦拜克镇发生Nyang与Pakam两族群武装青年之间的激烈冲突，并蔓延至多个居民区。据当地官员称，冲突已造成人数尚未确认的人员死亡和受伤，居民纷纷逃往周边村庄避难。政府安全部队已部署至伦拜克以控制局势并解除武装青年的武装。目前冲突仍在多个居民区持续。

location.raw_text: Rumbek town, the capital of Lakes State

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹湖泊州首府伦拜克镇爆发Nyang与Pakam两族群武装青年之间的激烈冲突
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Heavy clashes between armed youths from the Nyang and Pakam communities have spread to Rumbek town, the capital of Lakes State

key_facts.fact: 冲突最初于周四在伦拜克中县郊外的Nyangkot村爆发，造成四人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The fighting initially broke out on Thursday in Nyangkot village, on the outskirts of Rumbek Central County, where four people were killed

key_facts.fact: 据当地官员称，最新冲突造成的死伤人数尚未确定
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Makuac said the number of people killed and wounded in the latest clashes had not yet been established as fighting continued in several residential areas of Rumbek

key_facts.fact: 政府安全部队已部署至伦拜克以控制暴力并解除武装青年的武装
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: government security forces had been deployed in Rumbek to contain the violence and disarm the armed youths

key_facts.fact: 居民和家庭逃往Ronga、Cueiadukan和Adol等附近村庄避难
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: prompting residents and families to flee to nearby villages, including Ronga, Cueiadukan and Adol, in search of safety

key_facts.fact: 武装青年在周五上午冲突中破坏并洗劫了伦拜克警察总部
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: armed youths had vandalized and looted the Rumbek police headquarters during Friday morning's clashes

uncertainties: 最新冲突造成的死亡和受伤人数尚未确定
冲突造成的死亡人数尚未获得确认
信息来自单一来源（Radio Tamazuj），尚缺乏交叉验证
